map/skyline.reason: the outer surface of the rock and of everything standing on it -- the sea bed, the cliff face, the shelves, the curtain's wall-head and the sky over every roof. This is what the silhouette is made of and it is read from the shore and from the sea; it is never floor a body is offered

z1/stand-backs.reason: Z1's own recesses, taken on unchanged: one body deep, so a thing that waits in one is not on the road until it steps out

z1/teeth.reason: the rock teeth in the surf at the cliff's foot -- what the drop ends on, and never ground the road offers a body

z2/gate/lodge.reason: the porter's lodge, grated shut across its own embrasure

z2/gate/wall-head.reason: the ward curtain's wall-head over the yard -- dressing read from below, never floor

z4/canopy.reason: the chapel canopy where it came down: broken timber to fight around

z4/rubble.reason: fallen masonry heaped along the west walk: cover to read, never floor to cross

z4/stations.reason: the three plinths of the hour-round: the bell is set down on them and nobody stands there

contract.no_body_majority_ack: A whole map is mostly outer surface. Every cell of the majority is `map/skyline`, which earns `facade` -- the air outside the piece reaches it -- and none of it is `posted`. The rock's top, the sea bed and the sky over every roof are what the silhouette is made of; the play space is the ground and the buildings standing on them.
